user.title: Select WeekAqua Bluetooth Light
user.description: Choose a discovered WeekAqua device from the list, or select manual entry.

manual.title: Enter WeekAqua MAC Address Manually
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your WeekAqua light (e.g. C8:47:80:60:C6:65).

bluetooth_confirm.title: Discovered WeekAqua Device
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found WeekAqua device: {name} ({address}). Do you want to add it?

error.invalid_mac: Invalid Bluetooth MAC address format (expected e.g. C8:47:80:60:C6:65).

abort.already_configured: This WeekAqua device is already configured.
